relations: The dancer holds the paper umbrella overhead by its handle, so tilting her wrist rotates the canopy above her head.
Her reflection in the studio mirror mirrors her pose, so any turn of her body produces a matching mirrored turn.
The umbrella canopy stays attached to the vertical shaft, so shifting the shaft moves the canopy as one rigid assembly.
Bare feet on the smooth floor allow pivoting, so weight shifts can rotate her stance while the umbrella follows.
